vehicle: 2013 Maruti Suzuki Alto 800 (FB308 • 0.8L F8D 12-Valve SOHC MPFI Petrol • BS-IV)

manual_sections.title: Section 0A — General Information & Periodic Maintenance Schedule
manual_sections.summary: Vehicle identification (MA3EUA61S...), jacking/lifting points, fluid capacities, fastener torque standards, and 10,000 km / 1-year service intervals.

key_specs.value: MA3EUA61S00... / F8DN...
Every 10,000 km or 12 months (2.7 L SAE 5W-30)
Every 20,000 km (NGK DCPR7E, gap 0.8-0.9 mm, 18 Nm)
Inspect at 60,000 km, Replace at 80,000 - 100,000 km (107 teeth)
Every 40,000 km or 3 years (Coolant 4.0 L, Gear Oil 2.1 L 75W-90)

manual_sections.routing_notes: VIN plate riveted on front bulkhead cowl top panel; engine serial number stamped on front-left lower block flange near gearbox bellhousing.

manual_sections.title: Section 1A — F8D 796cc 12-Valve Engine Mechanical, Cylinder Head & Timing Belt
manual_sections.summary: Complete overhaul data for the 3-cylinder 12-valve SOHC F8D aluminum cylinder head, cast-iron block, pistons, crankshaft journals, tappet clearances, and timing belt alignment.

key_specs.value: Standard: 14.0 bar (203 psi) | Limit: 11.5 bar | Max Diff: 1.0 bar
Intake (6 valves): 0.13 - 0.17 mm | Exhaust (6 valves): 0.23 - 0.27 mm
Step 1: 35 Nm -> Step 2: 55 Nm -> Step 3: Final 68-72 Nm (Criss-Cross from center)
0.05 mm max across diagonal; Manifold surface: 0.10 mm
Camshaft sprocket punch mark to upper backplate notch; Crank pulley arrow to oil pump housing TDC mark (Cyl #1 TDC)

manual_sections.routing_notes: Timing belt (MGP 12761-78G00, 107 teeth) routes Counter-Clockwise from Crankshaft Sprocket -> Tensioner Roller -> Camshaft Sprocket. Water pump is driven by the ribbed alternator V-belt outside the timing cover.

manual_sections.title: Section 1B — Engine Cooling System, Thermostat & Radiator Fan Control
manual_sections.summary: Pressurized closed-loop cooling circuit, 88°C wax-pellet thermostat, belt-driven centrifugal water pump, aluminum fin radiator, and ECM-controlled cooling fan relay.

key_specs.value: 1.1 bar (108 kPa / 15.6 psi)
Begins opening at 86.5 - 89.5°C | Full lift (>8 mm) at 100°C
Turns ON at 98°C (or immediately when A/C ON or ECT circuit open) | Turns OFF at 93°C
6.0 - 8.0 mm under 98 N (10 kgf) thumb pressure between crank and alternator

manual_sections.routing_notes: Upper radiator hose routes from thermostat housing (gearbox end of cylinder head) to top radiator tank; lower hose routes from bottom radiator tank to water pump inlet pipe behind exhaust manifold.

manual_sections.title: Section 1C — MPFI Fuel Delivery, Injectors, EVAP & PCV Emission Control
manual_sections.summary: Returnless multi-point fuel injection @ 3.5 bar, 3 top-feed electromagnetic injectors, charcoal canister EVAP purge solenoid, and crankcase PCV valve.

key_specs.value: 3.4 - 3.6 bar (350 kPa) regulated inside fuel tank module

key_specs.parameter: Residual Hold Pressure (1 min after OFF)
key_specs.value: Minimum 2.5 bar (if lower, check fuel pump check-valve or leaking injector)
26 - 32 Ω at 20°C (ECM Pin C06 PWM controlled)

manual_sections.routing_notes: High-pressure nylon fuel supply line & EVAP vapor line run along left underbody floor pan channel from rear tank to engine bay firewall.

manual_sections.title: Section 1D — Electronic Ignition System (Coils, HT Cords & Spark Plugs)
manual_sections.summary: ECM-controlled solid-state ignition coils firing Cylinders 1-3-2, resistive high-tension silicone cords, and NGK DCPR7E nickel/iridium spark plugs.

key_specs.value: 1 - 3 - 2 (Cyl #1 at timing belt left side, Cyl #3 at flywheel/gearbox right side)
8° ± 3° BTDC @ 800 RPM (Base timing controlled by ECM CKP/MAP table)

manual_sections.routing_notes: HT leads must be routed in plastic separator clips away from the metal cylinder head lifting hook and O2 sensor harness to prevent cross-firing and EMI noise.

manual_sections.title: Section 1E — Starting & Charging System (Starter Motor, Alternator & Battery)
manual_sections.summary: 12V 0.8 kW planetary gear-reduction starter motor, 50A/55A internal-regulator alternator, and 35B20R / 38B20R maintenance-free battery.

key_specs.value: Must remain >= 9.6 V during starter cranking at 250 RPM
13.8 - 14.4 V @ 2,000 RPM with headlights and blower ON
< 25 mA with doors closed and ignition OFF for 5 minutes
>= 8.0 V at Terminal 50 (Black/Yellow wire from ignition switch)

manual_sections.routing_notes: Unfused 25 mm² Red/Black battery positive cable runs directly from Battery (+) to Starter Terminal 30; 80A Main Fusible Link feeds Alternator B+ and Fuse Box.

manual_sections.title: Section 1F — Electronic Engine Control (ECM Bosch ME17.9.71 / Delphi MT22.1)
manual_sections.summary: Complete 60-pin/94-pin ECM terminal voltages, waveforms, sensor 5V reference bus, KWP2000 / CAN bus diagnostics, and idle speed learning.

key_specs.value: 4.85 - 5.15 V shared by MAP, TPS, and CMP/Ref sensors
< 0.05 V drop to battery negative
Bolted to G3 on back of F8D intake manifold plenum
Pin 7 K-Line (ISO 14230-4 Fast Init 0x10) & Pins 6/14 CAN (ISO 15765-4 500 kbps)

manual_sections.routing_notes: ECM is mounted on the engine bay bulkhead / passenger glovebox cowl bracket depending on BS-IV production batch; main harness grommet passes through right passenger firewall.

manual_sections.title: Section 2A — Clutch System (160mm Diaphragm Clutch & Cable Adjustment)
manual_sections.summary: Cable-actuated mechanical release fork, 160mm dry single-plate friction disc, diaphragm pressure plate, and pilot/release bearings.

key_specs.value: 15 - 20 mm at pedal pad (2 - 4 mm at release lever arm nut)
Minimum 0.3 mm (Standard 1.2 mm) — MGP 22400-68K00
23 Nm tightened diagonally in 3 stages
61 Nm with medium-strength threadlocker

manual_sections.routing_notes: Clutch cable (MGP 23710-68K00) routes from clutch pedal clevis through driver firewall, looping smoothly behind battery tray to transaxle release lever.

manual_sections.title: Section 2B — 5-Speed Manual Transaxle (5MT) & Front Driveshafts (CV Joints)
manual_sections.summary: Constant-mesh 5-speed synchromesh gearbox, dual-cable floor shifter mechanism, differential side gears, and inboard tripod / outboard Birfield CV joints.

key_specs.value: 2.1 Liters SAE 75W-90 API GL-4 (Drain & Fill Plug Torque: 23 Nm)
175 Nm (Stake collar into axle spindle groove after torquing)
3-Pin Hall sensor on differential housing (MGP 34960-68K00, 9 Nm)

manual_sections.routing_notes: Selector and shift cables route under center console heat shield; left driveshaft is shorter (solid bar), right driveshaft is longer.

manual_sections.title: Section 3A — Steering Rack & Column-Mounted Electric Power Steering (EPS)
manual_sections.summary: Manual rack-and-pinion gear with steering column-mounted brushless DC assist motor, optical/magnetic torque sensor, and EPS control unit (LXi/VXi).

key_specs.parameter: Tie Rod End Ball Stud Nut Torque
key_specs.value: 43 Nm with new split cotter pin
40A / 50A Slow-Blow Fuse in Engine Room Fuse Box
Receives VSS pulse and ECM RPM pulse; enters fail-safe if RPM > 500 with 0V motor output

manual_sections.routing_notes: EPS control module is bolted directly under the steering column behind the speedometer cluster.

manual_sections.title: Section 3B — Front MacPherson Strut & Rear 3-Link Coil Suspension
manual_sections.summary: Front strut damper assembly, lower control arm with integrated ball joint, stabilizer bar link bushes, and rear trailing arms with Panhard lateral rod.

key_specs.value: 85 Nm

key_specs.parameter: Lower Control Arm Ball Joint Pinch Bolt
key_specs.value: 55 Nm (Tighten at curb ride height)
85 Nm (12-inch steel wheels, 145/80 R12 tire pressure: 30 psi Front / 30 psi Rear)

manual_sections.routing_notes: Inspect lower arm rubber bushings and stabilizer bar D-bushes on front crossmember every 10,000 km for knocking noises on rough roads.

manual_sections.title: Section 4A — Hydraulic Brakes, Vacuum Booster & Rear Drum Assembly
manual_sections.summary: Vacuum-assisted tandem master cylinder, diagonal split hydraulic circuits, front floating-caliper disc brakes, and rear self-adjusting drum brakes.

key_specs.value: Standard: 10.0 mm (Solid) / 17.0 mm (Ventilated) | Wear Limit: -2.0 mm
2.0 mm remaining friction material (MGP 55810-68K00)
Standard: 180.0 mm | Service Limit: 181.5 mm
4 to 7 notches at 200 N pull force (Brake fluid DOT 3 / DOT 4)

manual_sections.routing_notes: Brake bleeding sequence (Right-Hand Drive India): 1) Rear Left -> 2) Front Right -> 3) Rear Right -> 4) Front Left.

manual_sections.title: Section 5A — Body Electrical, Lighting, Wipers, Horn & Instrument Cluster
manual_sections.summary: Combination headlamp/turn switch, H4 60/55W halogen headlamps, wiper motor park circuit, digital fuel/odometer LCD cluster, and immobilizer transponder.

key_specs.value: 12V 60/55W H4 Halogen (Negative-switched via combination stalk)
Full: 3 - 7 Ω | Half: 32 - 38 Ω | Empty: 105 - 115 Ω
125 kHz RF ring antenna around ignition key cylinder (DTC P1610/P1614)

manual_sections.routing_notes: Maruti Suzuki uses negative-switched (ground-switched) headlamp circuits: +12V is fed to the H4 common terminal via Left/Right 15A fuses when headlamp relay closes, and the stalk switches High/Low beam to ground G4/G5.

manual_sections.title: Section 6A — Heating, Ventilation & Air Conditioning (HVAC & A/C Compressor)
manual_sections.summary: Subros rotary vane / scroll A/C compressor, magnetic clutch coil, high/low dual-pressure cut-off switch, evaporator anti-freeze thermistor, and 4-speed blower.

key_specs.value: HFC-134a (R134a): 320 ± 20 grams | Compressor Oil: PAG 46 / SP-10
Low Pressure OFF: < 2.0 bar | High Pressure OFF: > 31.4 bar
Cuts compressor OFF at 1.5°C to prevent core icing; turns back ON at 4.0°C

manual_sections.routing_notes: When the cabin A/C button is pressed and blower is >= Speed 1, the HVAC amplifier signals ECM Pin C55; the ECM first steps up IACV by +25 steps to raise idle to 900 RPM before grounding the A/C Compressor Relay (Pin C07).
